doc.description: Interpolation of control effectivenss matrix of a quadplane (4 motors + 2 elevons + 1 pusher)

define.name: RX
define.description: Rotor x positions [m], order: FR, RR, RL, FL

define.name: RY
define.description: Rotor y positions [m], order: FR, RR, RL, FL

define.name: RZ
define.description: Rotor z positions [m], order: FR, RR, RL, FL

define.name: SPIN_DIR
define.description: Motors spin direction (+1 for CW. -1 for CCW)

define.name: ROTOR_K_T_PPRZ
define.description: Quadratic thrust model: T = b*u + c*u^2, value = {b [N/pprz], c [N/pprz^2]}

define.name: KAPPA
define.description: Drag-torque to thrust ratio (kappa = k_m/k_t) [m]

define.name: MOTOR_HOVER
define.description: Hover motor command

define.name: MOTOR_IDLE
define.description: Idle motor command

define.name: ROTOR_ROT_X
define.description: Rotations on motors X axis FR BR BL FL

define.name: ROTOR_ROT_Y
define.description: Rotations on motors Y axis FR BR BL FL

define.name: ROTOR_ROT_Z
define.description: Rotations on motors Z axis FR BR BL FL

define.name: K_LIFT
define.description: Wing lift derivative: dL/d(alpha) = k_lift * V^2 [N/rad]

define.name: V_WING
define.description: Airspeed at which wing lift derivative is applied [m/s]

define.name: K_ELEVON_DEFLECT
define.description: delta = k*pprz [rad/pprz], = delta_max / MAX_PPRZ

define.name: K_ELEVON_ROLL
define.description: dMx/ddelta = k_roll * V^2 [N.m/rad per (m/s)^2]

define.name: K_ELEVON_PITCH
define.description: dMy/ddelta = k_pitch * V^2 [N.m/rad per (m/s)^2]

define.name: K_ELEVON_PROPWASH
define.description: dMy/ddelta += k_propwash * T_x * V (default 0)

define.name: K_ELEVON_DIFF_DRAG_YAW
define.description: dMz/ddelta = +/- k_yaw * V^2 * delta [N.m/rad]; + for right elevon

define.name: K_ELEVON_V_FULL
define.description: Elevons travel opening with dynamic pressure

define.name: ELEVON_RATE
define.description: Elevon rate

define.name: PUSHER_RY
define.description: Lateral Offset from CG (positive = right)

define.name: PUSHER_RZ
define.description: Vertical Offset from CG (positive = down)

define.name: PUSHER_SPIN_DIR
define.description: Pusher spin direction (+1 for CW. -1 for CCW)

define.name: PUSHER_K_T_PPRZ
define.description: Quadratic thrust model: T = b*u + c*u^2, value = {b [N/pprz], c [N/pprz^2]}

define.name: MOTOR_HOVER
define.description: Motor command in hover [pprz]

define.name: MOTOR_IDLE
define.description: Motor command in idle [pprz]
